recovery.disableSet: Disable the Set source in RouterControl, then disable the pool in the governed registry.
recovery.staleQuotes: Stop firming, clear quote caches, verify RFQ and RPC block freshness, then request new quotes.
recovery.residualAssets: Pause execution, preserve transaction evidence, revoke the exact pool allowance, and recover only through governance.
recovery.rollback: Restore the previous verified manifest and RFQ pool configuration; never reuse a consumed quote id.
